config.purpose: Add a role-general public coordination baseline, learn three targeted mafia response families, and solve a frozen expanded restricted matrix
config.selection: Select one response per named family on train only. Solve the exact zero-sum equilibrium of all 7x13 empirical train payoffs with Fraction arithmetic. Freeze both mixtures, then evaluate their lower/upper responses on untouched holdout. A post-hoc holdout restricted solution diagnoses drift and cannot change promotion.
config.interpretation: The public coordination policies are executable role-general protocols based on public speech order and nomination history. The equilibrium is restricted to listed fixed policies and empirical Monte Carlo payoffs; it is not full-game GTO.

intervals: Pointwise exploratory 95%; no multiplicity correction. Paired Wald plus conservative Hoeffding.
outcome: good faction terminal win, 0/1; no rollout truncation

paired.normal_interval_warning: Exploratory Wald interval; zero sample variance does not prove equality.
